overall_goal: Perform various kitchen management tasks including cleaning up food waste, preparing appliances, and managing cooking processes

goals.description: Put away unused items and ingredients
goals.rationale: The person returns the scissors, onions, oil bottle, and scale to their respective storage places.

goals.description: Clean up onion peels from the chopping board
goals.rationale: The person gathers onion peels from the chopping board and countertop and disposes of them in the food waste bin.

goals.description: Clean up garlic peels and other food waste
goals.rationale: The person clears garlic peels and dropped onion pieces into the food waste bin to keep the workspace clean.

goals.description: Manage the wooden spoon and pan contents
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a wooden spoon and taps it against the pan to drop stuck onion pieces into the food.

goals.description: Search for a lid in the cupboard
goals.rationale: The person opens the cupboard, lifts pots to find a lid, and returns an unsuitable lid before closing the door.
The person moves the pan, turns on the heat, distributes oil, and covers it with a lid.

goals.description: Assemble the food processor for juicing
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the food processor bowl and juicer parts and assembles them on the motor base.

goals.description: Clear used utensils to the sink
goals.rationale: The person moves dirty utensils like the spatula, knife, and garlic presser into the sink for washing.

goals.description: Fill and turn on the kettle
goals.rationale: The person opens the kettle, fills it with water from the tap, places it on its base, and switches it on.

goals.description: Store the plastic bag in the drawer
goals.rationale: The person crumples a plastic bag and places it inside a drawer to keep it away from the hot kettle.

goals.description: Put the chicken in the oven and set the timer
goals.rationale: The person places the tray of marinated chicken into the oven and sets the cooking timer.

goals.description: Dispose of packaging in the trash
goals.rationale: The person crumples the empty chicken stock packaging and throws it into the trash bin.
